description: Aerogeneradores de Castilla-La Mancha is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. Details of wind turbines in service of wind farms authorised by the competent energy authority in Castilla-La Mancha: UTM coordinates, altitude, hub height, rotor radius, total height and unit power. Source: Open geographic data download. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. The portal shows the English title as "Category: Wind turbines in Castile-La Mancha" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad Autónoma de Castilla-La Mancha. Its keywords include Renovables, Aerogenerador, Producción, Eólico, Parque. The listing shows 3 download or service links in MS-EXCEL, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2025-05-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/es/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
